facts.fact: Le Matin reports that Fondation Al Mada with inwi, Managem, Nareva and Injaz Al Maghrib, in collaboration with the Ministry of National Education, is launching a new phase of the Classes Connectees Dir iddik programme equipping 40 more rural primary schools with connected multimedia rooms, with teachers trained in coding, robotics and AI under the ministerial Coding pour Tous programme to run workshops for sixth-year pupils.

systems.owner: Fondation Al Mada with inwi, Managem, Nareva, Injaz Al Maghrib and the Ministry of National Education
